effect.ru: Больше веса на левом заднем и правом переднем: вход стабильнее, выход с виража увереннее.
effect.en: More weight on the left rear and right front: a more stable entry and better drive off the corner.

tradeoff.ru: Слишком много — блокируется левое переднее на торможении.
tradeoff.en: Too much locks the left front under braking.

source.quote: Higher Cross Weight values will add weight to the left-rear and right-front, both stabilizing entry and helping drive-off on corner exit.

effect.ru: Машина свободнее в повороте и охотнее поворачивает; левое переднее меньше блокируется.
effect.en: The car is freer in the corner and rotates more; the left front locks less.

tradeoff.ru: Слишком мало — нестабильный вход и выход.
tradeoff.en: Too little gives an unstable entry and exit.

source.quote: Lower Cross-Weight values will help the vehicle rotate and keep it "free" in the corner to prevent speed from being lost, however too low can result in unstable entry and exit.

effect.ru: Задней оси легче поворачивать машину — особенно на коротких трассах.
effect.en: The rear rotates the car more easily, especially on short tracks.

source.quote: Smaller tracks will also see benefits from lower Nose Weight values, as it will allow the rear of the vehicle to rotate easier.

effect.ru: Машина устойчивее держит направление на скорости.
effect.en: The car is more directionally stable at speed.

tradeoff.en: It rotates less on short tracks.

source.quote: Higher Nose Weight values result in a more directionally-stable vehicle, good for low-grip tracks and situations where the vehicle is set up with extra front downforce.
